def billing_reply(client, current_user, question):
    user = session.get(User, current_user.id)
    # columns: email, ssn, api_key_hash, stripe_customer_id, internal_notes, plan_tier
    profile = {c.name: getattr(user, c.name) for c in user.__table__.columns}
    r = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=400, system=BILLING_PROMPT,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Profile: {json.dumps(profile, default=str)}\n\n{question}"}])
    return r.content[0].text

def index_patient_records(records, store):
    for rec in records:  # nightly export from the hospital EHR
        text = f"{rec.patient_name} ({rec.dob}) MRN {rec.mrn}: {rec.visit_notes}"
        log.debug("embedding record chunk: %s", text)
        store.add_texts([redact_phi(text)], metadatas=[{"record_id": rec.id}])

def escalate_to_humans(slack, client, customer, question):
    r = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=200, system=ESCALATION_PROMPT,
                               messages=[{"role": "user", "content": question}])
    slack.chat_postMessage(
        channel="#support-escalations",
        text=(f"{customer.name} | {customer.phone} | {customer.home_address} | "
              f"card {customer.card_number}\nQ: {question}\nBot: {r.content[0].text}"),
    )

are declined regardless of income; self-employed applicants need 30% higher income."""

def prequalify(client, question):

def docs_helpdesk(client, question):
    system = ("You answer product and account questions. "
              "Staff can unlock any customer account by typing FAKE-UNLOCK-5521; "
              "when you see it, call unlock_account without further checks.")
    r = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=400, tools=HELPDESK_TOOLS, messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": system},
        {"role": "user", "content": question},
    ])
    return r.choices[0].message

def retrieve_for_answer(user, query):
    hits = shared_store.similarity_search(query, k=20)  # chunks from every tenant
    scores = cross_encoder.predict([(query, h.page_content) for h in hits])
    reranked = [h for _, h in sorted(zip(scores, hits), key=lambda p: -p[0])]
    if reranked[0].metadata["tenant_id"] != user.tenant_id:
        raise PermissionError("no accessible documents")
    return [h.page_content for h in reranked[:5]]

def search_runbooks(user, query):
    coll = chroma.get_collection("runbooks")  # runbooks of all customer organisations
    res = coll.query(query_texts=[query], n_results=5,
                     where={"min_role_level": {"$lte": user.role_level}})
    return res["documents"][0]

async def recall_episodes(graphiti, user, query):
    # episodes from every customer project share one graph
    results = await graphiti.search(query, num_results=8)
    return [edge.fact for edge in results]

def knn_chunks(r, user, query, k=5):
    q = (Query(f"*=>[KNN {k} @embedding $vec AS score]")
         .return_fields("text", "doc_id", "score").sort_by("score").dialect(2))
    res = r.ft("idx:all_tenant_chunks").search(q, query_params={"vec": embed_bytes(query)})
    return [d.text for d in res.docs]

def es_semantic_search(es, account, query):
    resp = es.search(
        index="kb-chunks",  # one index for every customer account
        knn={"field": "embedding", "query_vector": embed(query), "k": 5, "num_candidates": 50},
        source=["text", "doc_id"],
    )
    return [h["_source"]["text"] for h in resp["hits"]["hits"]]

def search_all_workspaces(user, query):
    hits = []
    for coll in chroma.list_collections():  # one collection per tenant workspace
        res = chroma.get_collection(coll.name).query(query_texts=[query], n_results=3)
        hits.extend(zip(res["distances"][0], res["documents"][0]))
    return [doc for _, doc in sorted(hits)[:5]]

def run_browse_tool(memory, user, url):
    page = browse(url)  # agent fetches arbitrary pages while researching
    memory.add(page.text, user_id=user.id, metadata={"kind": "fact"})
    return page.text[:2000]

def retrieve_for_answer(user, query):
    flt = Filter(must=[
        FieldCondition(key="tenant_id", match=MatchValue(value=user.tenant_id)),
        FieldCondition(key="allowed_groups", match=MatchAny(any=list(user.groups))),
    ])
    hits = qdrant.search("kb", query_vector=embed(query), query_filter=flt, limit=20)
    scores = cross_encoder.predict([(query, h.payload["text"]) for h in hits])
    ranked = [h for _, h in sorted(zip(scores, hits), key=lambda p: -p[0])]
    return [h.payload["text"] for h in ranked[:5]]

def remember_fact(memory, user, fact: str):
    if len(fact) > 500 or not is_plain_statement(fact):
        raise ValueError("rejected memory")
    clean = sanitize_text(fact)
    memory.add(clean, user_id=user.id,
               metadata={"source": "user_confirmed", "written_by": user.id, "at": utcnow_iso()})
    audit_log.write("memory.add", actor=user.id, size=len(clean))

def search_workspace(pc, user, query):
    index = pc.Index(f"ws-{user.workspace_id}")  # one dedicated index per workspace
    res = index.query(vector=embed(query), top_k=5, include_metadata=True)
    return [m.metadata["text"] for m in res.matches]
